app_info.subtitle: Local agent control
app_info.description: AgentDeck helps users inspect a local AI agent workspace from ChatGPT by scanning installed tools, providers, running processes, MCP configuration, graph relationships, handoff runs, and audit events without modifying external configurations.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only inspects local tools, providers, processes, configs, and normalized entities without changing them.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish, send, or modify public internet state or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Builds and returns a graph snapshot from the current local environment scan without writing data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish, send, or modify public internet state or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

test_cases.description: Inspect the current local AgentDeck environment.
test_cases.user_prompt: Scan my AgentDeck environment and summarize which agents, providers, and tools are available.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a concise summary of discovered local agents, providers, processes, configs, and tool availability.

test_cases.description: Explain the local agent relationship graph.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show me how my local agents, providers, tools, and configs are connected.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns graph nodes and edges with a readable explanation of the relationships.

test_cases.description: List local source agents for handoff planning.
test_cases.user_prompt: Which source agents does AgentDeck currently see for handoffs?
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the discovered local agents, their statuses, and enough context to choose a source agent.

test_cases.description: Review configured MCP servers without starting them.
test_cases.user_prompt: Audit my local MCP server configs and call out risky or missing server definitions.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns configured MCP servers, transports, env key names, command availability, and risk reasons without invoking servers.

test_cases.user_prompt: Run an AgentDeck health check and tell me what is ready or missing.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns readiness results for required local tools and provider checks with actionable missing items.

test_cases.user_prompt: Fetch handoff run run:agent-codex:xai:example and summarize its result.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the matching stored handoff run when present or explains that no matching run was found.

test_cases.user_prompt: Search my AgentDeck audit log for recent xAI handoff activity.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns recent local audit records matching the query and summarizes any relevant activity.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for creating external issues.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Create a public GitHub issue for every missing provider in this project.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because AgentDeck only inspects local control-plane state and does not create public issues.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for sending messages.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Send my latest handoff result to the team in Slack.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because sending external messages is outside the read-only AgentDeck MCP workflows.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for editing third-party agent configuration.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Rewrite my Claude and Codex MCP config files to add every server you can find.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked for config modification because the MCP tools only inspect local state and do not edit configuration files.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for unrelated calendar requests.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: What meetings do I have tomorrow morning?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because calendar lookup is outside AgentDeck's supported local developer-control workflows.
